fields.description: Master kill switch for eTIMS integration. When unchecked, no documents should be auto-submitted to KRA eTIMS (enforced by hook/queue logic elsewhere, not by this field alone).
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: KRA-issued taxpayer PIN (eTIMS `tin`).
fields.label: KRA PIN (TIN)

fields.description: KRA-assigned branch/office identifier for this business location (eTIMS `bhfId`).
fields.label: Branch ID (bhfId)

fields.description: SDC ID / CU ID for this device (eTIMS `sdcId`), decrypted/plaintext. Fill in either this or the matching Encrypted field on the right — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: SDC ID (CU ID) — Decrypted

fields.description: Serial number of the registered control unit device (eTIMS `dvcSrlNo`), decrypted/plaintext. Fill in either this or the matching Encrypted field on the right — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: Device Serial Number (dvcSrlNo) — Decrypted

fields.description: MRC number for this device (eTIMS `mrcNo`), decrypted/plaintext. Fill in either this or the matching Encrypted field on the right — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: MRC No — Decrypted

fields.description: Communication key (eTIMS `cmcKey`) used to secure device communication with KRA eTIMS, decrypted/plaintext. Fill in either this or the matching Encrypted field on the right — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: CMC Key — Decrypted

fields.description: Interchange key (eTIMS `intrlKey`), decrypted/plaintext. Fill in either this or the matching Encrypted field on the right — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: Interchange Key — Decrypted

fields.description: Signing key (eTIMS `signKey`) used to sign invoice payloads, decrypted/plaintext. Fill in either this or the matching Encrypted field on the right — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: Sign Key — Decrypted

fields.description: SDC ID / CU ID as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob. Fill in either this or the matching Decrypted field on the left — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: SDC ID (CU ID) — Encrypted

fields.description: Device serial number as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob. Fill in either this or the matching Decrypted field on the left — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: Device Serial Number (dvcSrlNo) — Encrypted

fields.description: MRC number as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob. Fill in either this or the matching Decrypted field on the left — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: MRC No — Encrypted

fields.description: CMC Key as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob. Fill in either this or the matching Decrypted field on the left — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: CMC Key — Encrypted

fields.description: Interchange Key as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob. Fill in either this or the matching Decrypted field on the left — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: Interchange Key — Encrypted

fields.description: Sign Key as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob. Fill in either this or the matching Decrypted field on the left — saving fills in the other one automatically.
fields.label: Sign Key — Encrypted

fields.description: Base URL for the KRA eTIMS sandbox/test API environment. Only used while Environment is set to Sandbox.
fields.label: Sandbox Base URL

fields.description: Base URL for the live KRA eTIMS production API environment. Only used while Environment is set to Production.
fields.label: Production Base URL

fields.description: OAuth/API secret used to authenticate with KRA eTIMS.
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: PIN for the control unit.
fields.label: Control Unit PIN

fields.description: Cached bearer/auth token returned by the KRA eTIMS auth endpoint, so requests can reuse it instead of re-authenticating every call. Small Text (not Data) since bearer tokens can run well past 140 characters.
fields.label: Cached Auth Token

fields.description: Expiry timestamp of the cached auth token. Used to decide whether to refresh the token before the next API call.
fields.label: Token Expires At

fields.description: AES-128 key (hex) used to decrypt/encrypt the SDC ID, Device Serial Number, MRC No, CMC Key, Interchange Key, and Sign Key pairs above (scheme: AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding, Base64). Required whenever one of those pairs needs syncing on save.
fields.label: AES Key

fields.description: When enabled (and Enabled is checked), submitted Sales Invoices are automatically queued for submission to KRA eTIMS.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Sales Invoices

fields.description: When enabled (and Enabled is checked), new/updated Items are automatically queued for registration with KRA eTIMS.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Items
